speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The feedback from SMEs has been very positive.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: An example of a local SME that has benefited from its partnership with a COI is You Tiao Man.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The Food Innovation and Resource Centre (FIRC) COI which is located at Singapore Polytechnic helped refine the company's frozen "you tiao", that is, fried dough, manufacturing methods to improve the product's taste and quality, which then led to its successful commercialisation.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The company is now supplying the frozen "you tiao" to many hotels, restaurants, airlines and food service companies.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: In addition, it has expanded into the B2C market by selling frozen "you tiao" directly to customers online and at retail outlets island-wide.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: As announced in Budget 2022, the Government has increased support for local SMEs and, in particular, for R&D and innovation activities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Besides the COIs, SMEs can also leverage our IHLs' capabilities by participating in technology collaborations and joint projects conducted by the academia and industry partners.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Through such partnerships, our SMEs can strengthen their technical competencies, stay up-to-date and learn the latest research trends and developments.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: This programme encourages and enables research collaborations between the public sector and the industry to bring promising technologies to market.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: The first one is: how do these Centres of Innovation serve, assist and benefit the SMEs?

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: The second would be: how does MTI intend to reach out to more SMEs to accelerate the pace of innovation and to foster greater innovation amongst SMEs?

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I want to thank the Member Desmond Choo for his supplementary questions – I believe there are two.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: And I want to assure him that MTI and ESG will certainly give our strong support to SMEs that want to embark on technology innovation.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: SMEs can tap on a wide range of resources at the eight COIs, or Centres of Innovation.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Each of the Centres of Innovation is a one-stop hub that supports our SMEs' technology innovation efforts, based on a sectorial approach.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: For example, I talked about the Food Innovation and Resource Centre (FIRC) that is located at Singapore Polytechnic.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: We have other COIs that focus on environment and water technology, supply chain management – which is located at Republic Polytechnic – and electronics and the Internet of Things.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: On his question on how a COI can assist and serve the SMEs, besides access to laboratory facilities, consultancies and training courses, SMEs can also receive help in feasibility studies and productivity improvements.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I also want to assure the Member that MTI and ESG work very closely with A*STAR.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: In terms of outreach, the COI staff will work very closely with ESG to extend outreach to SMEs, especially the trade associations and chambers, the industry associations.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: FIRC that is located at Singapore Polytechnic has very close links with the Singapore Food Manufacturers' Association.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: As for the Republic Polytechnic's COI that focuses on supply chain management, I know that they hold a monthly industry outreach event for their SMEs, showcasing the technologies that they have developed, and also past projects.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I want to assure the Member that MTI, ESG and A*STAR will work closely with COIs to support our SMEs' technology innovation efforts.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Is there perhaps an online mechanism where they can access these patents and see whether they can enter into negotiations to license these patents for their own operations?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Notwithstanding that there are occasional meet-ups, gatherings and so on, is there this easy, online matching mechanism, for example?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Thirdly, in the view of the Government, are these mechanisms working well right now to generate commercial impact?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: Lastly, does the Government regularly benchmark the performance of other IHLs and innovation ecosystems around the world which are noted to be very good at bridging between academic research and commercial impact?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: I understand the Israelis, for example, are very good at this.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: They tend to generate very high commercial impact from academic R&D.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I want to reassure him that ESG and MTI, as well as A*STAR, work very closely with not just the COIs.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I talked about the 80 Technology, Innovation and Enterprise (TIE) centres.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: It can translate into technology translation, IP licensing, product development, R&D, prototyping of solutions, proof of concept (POC) and also collaboration with larger enterprises.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: On one of the questions the Member asked, yes, certainly, we work very closely, between A*STAR and EDB.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: I believe we have the Singapore-Israel Industrial R&D Foundation (SIIRD).

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: We collaborate with Israeli's R&D side, sharing our best practices and so on.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: For example, we will assess if they are effective at enhancing our enterprises' competitiveness.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: ESG will work very closely with A*STAR to facilitate the discussion and to help them navigate the various RIs.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: Whether it is in the area of sustainability or electronics, there are sectoral RIs to support their technology innovation efforts.

speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
text: We can take the discussion further, like what I have mentioned, using the COI as an example.
